title: Local slice comparison and projection compatibility
statement: theorem ringedProjectionRestriction_local {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (R_Y : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (R_X : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ≅ R_X) (g : Global f R_Y R_X c) : ∃ data : ∀ V : Y.ProEt, Local f R_Y R_X c g V, ∀ V : Y.ProEt, (data V).ProjectionCompatible

proof.text: The local construction applies the ordinary localization square, K-injective restriction, tensor comparison, and counit mate calculation on each slice.
